Every label is cross-checked against the page headings.
Lists are bounded by the demo character's level (38) and by which tabs were opened on stream; a tab in coverage.tabsMissing was never shown, so its spells are absent, not missing from the game.

No page listed one spell at two ranks, so 'Show all spell ranks' was off or the character knew one rank; ranksSeen is the highest rank known, not the full set.

Page headings the reader could not resolve to a tab, because a hover tooltip stood over them: Exac, Instant, Requires Battle Stance. Their entries are in this file without a tab and say so in source.note.
